title: A Deadly Fire, a Succession Leak, and the Battle Over China’s Future
text:
A deadly shipyard fire in Qingdao. Xi Jinping reacts within hours. Videos disappear from Chinese social media. Then a leaked 21st Party Congress lineup names Hu Chunhua as a possible successor.Are these separate stories—or signs of growing pressure inside Xi’s system? This video analyzes a deadly fire aboard the *Ocean Melody* in Qingdao, suggesting the ship was part of a \"shadow fleet\" transporting Russian military materials. It further examines a leaked personnel list for the 21st Party Congress, which hints at a potential power struggle within the CCP and a shift from Xi Jinping's loyalists toward reformists and technocrats.
